input: A unit may commit an order of the form "attack E<n>" only if E<n> equals /world/focus.text, so that all living units in /team/units focus fire on the same enemy closest to the squad's centre instead of splitting targets or switching between E1 and E2. (Writing the formula: num_*, bool_* and text_* predicates read the contract's accepted state, from before the commit being checked, so they never see the value a commit writes. To test the order a commit writes, use +sets(/orders/<unit>.text, "<order>"). Paths: /world/step.num /world/allies_alive.num /world/enemies_alive.num /world/focus.text /world/<unit>/hp.num /world/<unit>/alive.bool /world/<A>/closest.text /world/<A>/in_range.num /orders/<A>.text)
response: always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E0") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E0")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E1") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E1")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E2") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E2")] false)
